name: Neuroscience
desc: Study of the nervous system and brain.

resources.name: Nengo
resources.desc: Library for creating and simulating large-scale brain models.

resources.name: Nitime
resources.desc: Timeseries analysis for neuroscience data.

resources.name: Nilearn
resources.desc: Module for performing statistical learning/machine learning on NeuroImaging data.

resources.name: DIPY
resources.desc: Toolbox for analysis of MR diffusion imaging.

resources.name: MNE-Python
resources.desc: Community-driven software for processing time-resolved neural signals including electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG).

resources.name: NiBabel
resources.desc: Provides read and write access to some common medical and neuroimaging file formats.

resources.name: PsychoPy
resources.desc: Package for running psychology and neuroscience experiments. It allows for creating psychology stimuli in Python.

resources.name: Brian2
resources.desc: Free, open source simulator for spiking neural networks.

resources.name: expyriment
resources.desc: Platform-independent lightweight Python library for designing and conducting timing-critical behavioural and neuroimaging experiments.

resources.name: BindsNET
resources.desc: Package for simulating spiking neural networks for reinforcement & machine learning.

resources.name: SpikeInterface
resources.desc: Framework designed to unify spike-sorting technologies

resources.name: NiMARE
resources.desc: NiMARE is a Python package for neuroimaging meta-analyses

resources.name: DeepLabCut
resources.desc: Markerless pose estimation toolkit for animal behavior analysis using transfer learning with deep neural networks.

resources.name: CaImAn
resources.desc: Computational toolbox for large-scale calcium imaging data analysis, including motion correction, source extraction, and deconvolution.

resources.name: Elephant
resources.desc: Library for the analysis of electrophysiology data, providing tools for spike train statistics, signal processing, and connectivity analysis.

resources.name: NEURON
resources.desc: Simulation environment for modeling individual neurons and networks of neurons, widely used in computational and systems neuroscience.

resources.name: Nipype
resources.desc: Workflow engine providing a uniform Python interface to existing neuroimaging packages (FSL, FreeSurfer, AFNI, SPM, ANTs) and flexible pipeline composition.

resources.name: PyNWB
resources.desc: Python API for reading and writing Neurodata Without Borders (NWB) files, the community standard data format for cellular-based neurophysiology data.

resources.name: fMRIPrep
resources.desc: Robust preprocessing pipeline for fMRI data that adapts to nearly any dataset and produces analysis-ready outputs with minimal manual intervention.

resources.name: AllenSDK
resources.desc: Toolkit for accessing and processing data from the Allen Institute for Brain Science, including the Allen Brain Atlas and Allen Brain Observatory.

resources.name: Suite2p
resources.desc: Pipeline for cell detection and signal extraction from large-scale two-photon calcium imaging recordings.

resources.name: Neo
resources.desc: Package for representing electrophysiology data in Python, with readers for a wide range of neurophysiology file formats.

resources.name: Monty
resources.desc: Sensorimotor learning framework based on the thousand brains theory of the neocortex.

resources.name: PyNoetic
resources.desc: A Modular Python Framework for No-Code Development of EEG Brain-Computer Interfaces supporting end-to-end BCI design.

resources.name: Brain Dynamics Toolbox
resources.desc: Open software for simulating dynamical systems in neuroscience.

resources.name: BrainStorm
resources.desc: Open-source application dedicated to the analysis of brain recordings (MEG, EEG, fNIRS, ECoG, depth electrodes and multiunit electrophysiology).

resources.name: EEGLAB
resources.desc: Interactive Matlab toolbox for processing continuous and event-related EEG, MEG and other electrophysiological data.

resources.name: FieldTrip
resources.desc: Toolbox for MEG and EEG analysis.

resources.name: Psychtoolbox-3
resources.desc: Free set of Matlab and GNU Octave functions for vision and neuroscience research.

resources.name: SPM
resources.desc: Free and open source software for the analysis of brain imaging data sequences (fMRI, PET, SPECT, EEG, MEG).

resources.name: Brayns
resources.desc: Minimalistic visualiser that can perform ray-traced rendering of neurons. Ray-tracing can help to highlight areas of neural circuits where cells touch each other and where synapses are being created leading to a better understanding of how individual cells and subsequently the brain functions.

resources.name: Brainbrowser
resources.desc: Library exposing set of web-based 3D visualization tools primarily targetting neuroimaging.

resources.name: jsPsych
resources.desc: Library for creating and running behavioural experiments in a web browser.

resources.name: nat: NeuroAnatomy Toolbox
resources.desc: Package for the (3D) visualisation and analysis of biological image data, especially tracings of single neurons.

resources.name: brainGraph
resources.desc: Package for performing graph theory analyses of brain MRI data.

resources.name: Neuroscience Online
resources.desc: Open-access electronic textbook and interactive courseware covering neuroscience in depth. Provided by the Department of Neurobiology and Anantomy at the University of Texas Medical School at Houston.

resources.name: Computational Cognitive Neuroscience
resources.desc: Text which provides an in-depth introduction to the main ideas in the computational cognitive neuroscience, a field which aims to understand the brain by using biologically based computational models.

resources.name: Neuronal Dynamics
resources.desc: Open-access electronic textbook that covers computational and theoretical neuroscience. Provided by École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL).

resources.name: Andy's Brain Book
resources.desc: Book companion to Andy's Brain Blog. Provides an introduction to working in a Unix environment, fMRI analysis, and commonplace neuroimaging tools and topics.

resources.name: NiPraxis
resources.desc: Textbook for the NiPraxis course, covers fundamental concepts in neuroimaging analysis and how they relate to the wider world of statistics, engineering and computer science. Learn how to work with data and code to get a deeper understanding of how fMRI methods work, how they can fail, how to fix them, and how to develop new methods.

resources.name: Neuroskeptic
resources.desc: Discover magazine's neuroscience blog which offers a look at the latest developments in neuroscience, psychiatry and psychology through a critical lens.

resources.name: Andy's Brain Blog
resources.desc: A large collection of articles, tutorials, and videos, covering many of the popular neuroimaging tools and methods.

resources.name: Introduction to Neuroscience | MIT OCW
resources.desc: Introduction to the mammalian nervous system, with emphasis on the structure and function of the human brain.

resources.name: Computational Neuroscience | Coursera
resources.desc: Provides an introduction to basic computational methods for understanding what nervous systems do and for determining how they function.

resources.name: Medical Neuroscience
resources.desc: Explores the functional organization and neurophysiology of the human central nervous system, while providing a neurobiological framework for understanding human behavior.

resources.name: Neuromatch Academy
resources.desc: Jupyter notebooks for the three-week intensive summer school in computational neuroscience.

resources.name: Quora
resources.desc: Neuroscience topic on Quora contains answers, often by experts, to questions ranging from basic to advanced.

resources.name: r/neuroscience
resources.desc: Subreddit for discussion of neuroscience news, research, and questions.

resources.name: StackExchange
resources.desc: Psychology and neuroscience StackExchange site.

resources.name: neuroimaging@python.org
resources.desc: A list for discussion of neuroimaging analysis in Python. Among other things, this list is home to discussions concerning NiPy projects (including NiBabel, Nilearn, dipy, MNE-Python, and more).

resources.name: On The Brain
resources.desc: Harvard Mahoney Neuroscience Institute's quarterly e-newsletter.

resources.name: BrainPost
resources.desc: A mailing list that delivers weekly easy-to-read summaries of the latest neuroscience publications.

resources.name: Awesome Public Datasets - Neuroscience
resources.desc: High-quality open neuroscience datasets.

resources.name: McCulloch & Pitts Neural Net Simulator
resources.desc: Simulator for a historical computational model based on neurons.

resources.name: ModelDB
resources.desc: Searchable database for computational neuroscience models.

resources.name: NeuroElectro
resources.desc: Searchable database of neurons and their electrophysiological properties (extracted from literature)

resources.name: Neuroscience Mindmap
resources.desc: Interactive mindmap containing curated resources for anyone interested in learning neuroscience.

resources.name: neuroSummerSchools
resources.desc: List of summer (and seasonal) summer schools in neuroscience and related fields.

resources.name: Brain Matters
resources.desc: Neuroscience podcast where real neuroscientists sit down and talk about the brain.

resources.name: NeuroHackademy
resources.desc: Summer school in neuroimaging and data science, held at the University of Washington eScience Institute. Lectures are available through the institute's YouTube channel.

resources.name: SORTED
resources.desc: SORTED: a list of interesting science ideas and links (cognitive/neuro & data science)

resources.name: BIDS
resources.desc: Brain Imaging Data Structure: community standard for organizing neuroimaging and behavioral data, supported by most modern neuroimaging tools.

resources.name: OpenNeuro
resources.desc: Free and open platform for sharing and analyzing neuroimaging data (MRI, MEG, EEG, iEEG, ECoG, ASL, PET).
